# ctxcap
Offline context-file budget management for AI coding agents; no API key, network, or configuration.
Use `npx -y ctxcap --json` for CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, Cursor rules, and prompt token usage and stale references.
MCP: `npx -y ctxcap-mcp`; call `context_budget_plan`, splice by startLine/endLine, never cut preserve, then call verify.
If satisfiable is false, report minAchievable and stop; measure deltas, not absolutes (counts are approximate +/-5%).
